name: MiniMax API
notes: Pay-as-you-go; the M Plan subscription is the separate MiniMax M Plan Provider and takes a different key type on the same base URL. The docs recommend the Anthropic-compatible API; the OpenAI-compatible one is at https://api.minimax.io/v1. Thinking blocks must be kept unchanged in later turns. Max output and cache write prices are not published; max output comes from models.dev and cache write is set to the input price; structured output is not mentioned. Caching is automatic prefix matching (512+ tokens); cache_control is not documented on the Anthropic-compatible API, so cacheMarkerLimit 0 keeps the gateway from adding markers. Release dates come from models.dev (https://models.dev/).

upstreamModels.notes: Thinking cannot be disabled. Cache write is not published; caching is automatic and a first pass is billed as input, so it is set to the input price. maxOutputTokens comes from models.dev.

Prices are the up-to-512K tier with the 'permanent 50% off' applied (list 0.60/2.40/0.12). Over 512K: 0.60/2.40/0.12. Cache write is not published; caching is automatic and a first pass is billed as input, so it is set to the input price. maxOutputTokens comes from models.dev.
